tools.name: list_setups
tools.description:
The setups: status available (open_session works) or soon (listed, cannot be opened yet), their modes (free,
    challenge) and their benches by kind (status open, or soon: not offered yet).

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Create a session (mode: free or challenge). Give open_url to the human: nothing simulates until they open it in their browser.

tools.name: push_to_editor
tools.description:
Replace the code in the human's browser and, if run, compile it in the lab's cloud and start it. The fallback
    of push_program: use it only when the toolchain to compile locally is missing (no arduino-cli, core or library).

tools.name: push_program

tools.name: set_visibility
tools.description: Change the visibility (private, link, public). Returns the viewer link; current viewers are disconnected.

tools.name: queue_join
tools.description: Take a place in the queue for benches of this kind (for example real or sim). The browser must be connected.

tools.name: queue_status
tools.description: The session's place: state none, waiting (position, estimated wait eta_s) or turn (bench, end of the turn ends_at, Unix seconds).

tools.name: queue_leave
tools.description: Give back the place in the queue, or the turn if it has started.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: End the session now, as when it expires: the place or turn ends, viewers and the browser are disconnected, everything is forgotten.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: The session's state without its events, cheap enough to poll: browser connected (owner), visibility, current viewer link (not renewed), viewers, created_at and expires_at (Unix seconds), run (compilations so far: event times restart at each), level and levels (null in free mode), capture ({id, kind,

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description:
Challenge mode: propose `value` as the answer of the current level's test `test` (an answer test of the level's
    brief). One answer per second at most. The hub checks it and returns {test, ok}; the verdict is also shown in the
    bench. For a hint, ask the visitor to reveal one in the bench.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "brief_submit" is 1769 chars, far longer than this server's median (309). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
